correctness.rationale: The smoothness resultant, all four Hasse–Witt polynomial entries, determinant and scheme multiplicities follow from exact coefficient expansion in F23; semilinear Frobenius-square has eigenvalue 13 over F529 at each nonzero root, so its stable p-rank is 1, not merely one-step rank 1. The center has zero matrix, the complement invertible. All four exceptional nonzero roots are one geometric scaling orbit. The embedded standalone program independently checks field arithmetic and the coefficients.

value.rationale: Complete natural p-rank and a-number classification for a distinguished one-parameter genus-two pencil specifically motivated by the recent generic ordinarity theorem. The simultaneous presence of a superspecial fat center and an intermediate-rank reduced orbit is mathematically meaningful: the multiplicity-four Hasse vanishing and rank-one Frobenius-stable orbit are absent from the generic theorem, and determine the exceptional stratification exactly rather than a routine isolated point count.
